settings.privacy.description: Your data stays yours. Here's what PlayStash sends.
settings.privacy.analytics.title: Help improve PlayStash
settings.privacy.analytics.descriptionDe: We'd like to send a few anonymous usage stats — which features you use and whether something goes wrong — so we know what to fix. Nothing personal, no game names, no IP-tracked browsing. It just helps us improve the app. You can turn it off anytime. Changes take effect after restarting the app.
settings.privacy.analytics.descriptionWe: We'd like to send a few anonymous usage stats — which features you use and whether something goes wrong — so we know what to fix. Nothing personal, no game names, no IP-tracked browsing. It just helps us improve the app. You can turn it off anytime. Changes take effect after reloading.
settings.privacy.analytics.ariaLabel: Help improve PlayStash with anonymous usage analytics

settings.developer.verboseLogging.title: Verbose diagnostics logging
settings.developer.verboseLogging.descri: Writes a periodic snapshot of the interface (page, memory, DOM size) and detailed activity breadcrumbs to the app log to help diagnose freezes. Enable it when a maintainer asks for it — PlayStash keeps detecting and automatically recovering from an unresponsive interface either way.
